references.text: Encourages seeking the Lord while He may be found and calling on Him while He is near, similar to the encouragement to pray in faith in Mark.
Highlights the importance of rejoicing in the Lord and trusting that He will give what the heart desires when one commits their way to Him, paralleling the aspect of faith in prayer.
Jesus teaches that all things asked for in prayer with faith will be received, which directly reflects the message in Mark.

Encourages asking, seeking, and knocking, with the promise that whoever asks receives; whoever seeks finds; and to whoever knocks, it will be opened, emphasizing the effectiveness of prayer when done in faith.

Explains that without faith it is impossible to please God, for whoever comes to God must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who sincerely seek Him, which resonates with the necessity of faith in Mark.
